source: Local 赛项二-室外5G远程驾驶无人车赛补充细则.pdf, pages 3-7
assumptions: Lane width and vehicle/camera/PWM geometry are not yet measured on the real car.
Switch position on the 60m straight is a chosen legal layout; task spacings follow the supplement.
Switch length uses 1.5m; page 3 wording about other zone lengths is ambiguous. Parking length is explicitly 1.5m.
QR is a non-payment placeholder at the switch exit; no real payment is performed.
Full autonomous segment starts with the car nose at 46.5m; remote driving is not simulated.
Horizontal LED lamp housing bottom is 0.40m, with saturated white cores and emissive intensity 3. Real lamp layout requires validation.
Chassis is a 2cm-thick low deck; original tall box obscured row 0.70. Footprint, camera and control calibration are unchanged. Real hood occlusion is unmeasured.
Zebra announcement is a logged event; school/team audio and payment are not simulated.
